mapper.select: SELECT p.thumbnail, c.cno, c.title, c.content FROM (SELECT cno, title, content, REGEXP_SUBSTR(pnos, '[^,]+', 1, 1) AS pno FROM (SELECT cno, title, content, pnos FROM course ORDER BY hit DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 4) c JOIN place p ON p.pno = TO_NUMBER(c.pno)
